# KFS plugin test coverage

<!-- Generated by `npm run coverage` from the test suite and shared/coverageNotes.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

What the automated tests check for each KFS RockShop plugin, in plain language. Two suites cover the plugins:

- **Functional tests** (`rocks.kfs.Tests.EndToEnd`) use each plugin on a running Rock test site, the way a person would, and check the result. They are listed below, plugin by plugin.
- **The compatibility preflight** (`rocks.kfs.Tests.Compile`) checks that each plugin's code still builds and compiles against a new Rock version. It does not run the plugin.

167 functional tests cover 13 of 20 plugins. Compile coverage is from the newest preflight report (Rock 20.0).

Plugins are named as in the shared Rock Packages folder. Setup steps for each suite are in its README.

## Advanced Check-in Monitor

Replaces the Live Metrics block of Rock's Check-in Manager with a room-by-room view of who is checked in, where staff can move, check out or remove people, view and reprint labels, open and close rooms, and set room thresholds.

Functional tests: **22**. Compile check: Yes (1 page).

### What is tested

**Launch**

- Carries core block settings (setup, copied page).
- Shows check-in type without warning (launch, manager page).
- Draws attendance chart (launch, manager page).
- Includes checked in person (launch, area count).

**Room**

- Lists checked in person with actions (navigate, area group room).
- Goes up a level (navigate, heading clicked).
- Finds checked in person (search, by name).
- Ends attendance and leaves room (checkout, person).
- Removes attendance (delete, person).
- Opens location dialog (move, person).
- Hides buttons (settings, attendee actions off).

**Move and labels**

- Ends old attendance and checks into new room (move, person to another room).
- Moves everyone to new room (move all, two people in room).
- Shows rendered label PDF (view label, checked in person).

**Open and close rooms**

- Inactivates location and reopens (close, room from its heading).
- Inactivates location (close, room from group list).

**Thresholds**

- Shows count out of threshold (threshold, soft threshold set).
- Flags room as full (threshold, room at soft threshold).
- Saves new threshold (threshold, edited in room heading).
- Hides threshold editor (threshold, no threshold).

**Location navigation mode**

- Campus location then room lists checked in person (navigate, location mode).
- Counts checked in person on room (navigate, location mode).

### Not tested

- Close Occurrence mode (closes a group's occurrence instead of the room; needs the KFS Load Balance Locations check-in workflow).
- The Include Group Move, Advanced Print Options and Search By Code settings.
- Sending a label to a printer (the plugin's print button is turned off in its code; the tests check the label preview).
- Rock's location tree in the Move dialog: the tests choose the new room directly, because Rock's REST API refuses the test sign-in the tree uses.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- The open/close tests need a one-time Administrate rule for the test role on the Check-in Manager site (README).

## Advanced Group Finder

KFS's version of Rock's Group Finder: lists groups people can join, with filters for campus, day, keyword, postal code and group attributes, and extra display settings.

Functional tests: **12**. Compile check: Yes (1 page).

### What is tested

**Filters**

- Lists public groups with room (page load, auto load).
- Shows only that group (keyword, word in description).
- Shows only that group (keyword, word in name).
- Shows only its groups (campus, second campus checked).
- Shows only monday groups (day of week, monday checked).
- Shows only prayer groups (attribute filter, topic prayer).
- Shows no groups (filters, day and campus that do not match).
- Prefill filters and show matches (URL parameters, topic and day).

**Settings**

- Lists non public group (show all groups, on).
- Lists full group (hide overcapacity groups, off).
- Filters only on search and clear resets (auto filter off, search then clear).
- Campus filter is drop down (single select filters, on).

### Not tested

- Postal-code proximity search (needs geocoded group locations).
- The map.
- Keyword search across group attributes.
- Collapsible filters and custom attribute sort.
- PersonGuid mode and Group Opportunities.

## Attended Checkin

NewSpring's attended (staff-run) check-in, maintained by KFS: staff search for a family, pick who is checking in and confirm rooms and schedules.

Functional tests: **21**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL, 5 pages).

### What is tested

**Admin**

- Lists test kiosk (admin, load).
- Lists test area (admin, select kiosk).
- Warns to select device (admin, OK without device).
- Warns to select area (admin, OK without area).
- Area toggled twice is deselected (admin).
- Opens search (admin, kiosk and area).

**Confirm**

- Lists people with room and schedule (confirm, selected family).
- Saves attendance without printer error (confirm, print all).
- Saves attendance and returns to search (confirm, done).
- Removes person (confirm, delete row).
- Opens activity select and returns (confirm, edit row).

**Family Select**

- Preselects eligible members (family select, default).
- Warns to pick person (family select, no person selected).
- Confirms only that person (family select, one person selected).
- Added to family and selected (add person, new person).
- Listed as visitor not family member (add visitor, new child).
- Selected and confirmable (add family, new family).

**Search**

- Finds family and members (search, by last name).
- Finds family (search, by phone).
- Warns minimum length (search, phone too short).
- Shows no results (search, no match).

### Not tested

- Printing labels (needs a printer; the test kiosk has none).
- Changing a person's group, room or schedule on the Activity Select page.
- The Override button and the on-screen keypad.
- Matching a kiosk by geolocation.

## Custom Group Reminder Emails

A job that reminds members of flagged groups about an upcoming meeting, by email or text, a set number of days before it.

Functional tests: **3**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL).

### What is tested

**Job**

- Emails members of reminder group only (run, send using email meeting tomorrow).
- Sends nothing (run, days prior not matching meeting).
- Texts member of reminder group (edit send using SMS and run).

### Not tested

- Choosing a different system communication for the reminder.
- Groups on schedules other than a simple weekly one.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- Each sending test notes what to check: the email in Edify's outgoing messages and the text on the phone.

## Eventbrite

Links Rock groups to Eventbrite events and brings each event's attendees into the group as members, with their ticket details.

Functional tests: **5**. Compile check: Yes (2 DLLs, 3 pages).

### What is tested

**Group viewer**

- Links group and shows Eventbrite buttons (save group, Eventbrite event selected).
- Adds attendees with ticket details (sync attendees, linked group).
- Clears event and hides buttons (unlink, linked group).

**Settings page**

- Shows authenticated with linked groups and events (page load, token and organization set).
- Creates group linked to event (create new Rock group, test event selected).

### Not tested

- Automatic syncing through the Eventbrite webhook (Sync.ashx); the tests sync with the Sync button.
- The Ticket Class data view filter.
- The New Event Statuses and Display Eventbrite Event Name settings.

### Known issues

Tests that fail because of these plugin bugs are reported as *known issue* rather than as new failures.

- On Rock 20 the group editor shows a plain text box for the Eventbrite Event attribute instead of a list of events (Rock 20's Group Detail is an Obsidian block, and the plugin's field type has no Obsidian editor), so linking a group from the group editor fails there.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- Creating the Eventbrite test event and registering an attendee (Eventbrite has no API for registering attendees).

## Fundraising Participant Summary

A job that emails each fundraising trip participant a summary of the gifts made toward their goal since the last run.

Functional tests: **3**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL).

### What is tested

**Job**

- Emails only the participant with the new gift (run, gift since last run).
- Emails every participant except opted out (run, send emails with zero donations on).
- Sends no emails (run, no gifts since last run).

### Not tested

- The Show Address and Show Amount settings.
- Choosing groups by Group Types instead of a single group.
- A custom system communication.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- Each sending test notes what to check in Edify's outgoing messages.

## KFS Fundraising Progress

A block that shows a fundraising group's progress toward its goal, overall and for each participant, with an Excel export.

Functional tests: **8**. Compile check: Yes (1 page).

### What is tested

**GroupId and GroupMemberId parameters**

- Shows group totals and each members progress (page load, group ID parameter).
- Shows only that member without group totals (page load, group member ID parameter).
- Shows no progress (page load, no group parameter or setting).

**Display settings and export**

- Hides title totals member details and export (page load, display settings off).
- Hides member list (page load, group member goals off).
- Downloads workbook named for group (export to Excel, group ID parameter).

**Show Specific Group setting**

- Shows that group (page load, show specific group setting without parameters).
- Parameter wins (page load, group ID parameter and show specific group setting).

### Not tested

- Turning display settings off one at a time: the tests turn them all off together, and Show Group Member Goals on its own.

## Microsoft 365 Utilities

A Lava shortcode that lists items from a Microsoft 365 calendar, and a job that launches a workflow for each new email in a Microsoft 365 mailbox.

Functional tests: **8**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL).

### What is tested

**KFS - EWS Calendar Items shortcode**

- EWS credentials are set and encrypted (global attributes).
- Renders without errors (render, documentation example).
- Returns item in window (render, thirty days back sixty forward).
- Returns latest item first (render, order desc).
- Renders nothing (render, no calendar mailbox).
- Reads calendar as calendar mailbox (render, no impersonate).
- Shows warning and logs Microsoft sign in error (render, invalid secret).

**Launch Workflow From EWS Account job**

- Launches one workflow for newest email and marks it (run job, max emails one).

### Not tested

- The job's One Workflow Per Conversation and Workflow Attributes settings.
- Marking processed emails in ways other than Read or Add Flag.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- When the Azure app's secret expires, the tests fail with AADSTS7000222; create a new secret and update the EWS Azure Secret global attribute and the test settings.

## Person Attributes Form Advanced

A multi-page form that updates a person's details and attributes, and can add them to a group, create a connection request, launch a workflow and ask for an electronic signature.

Functional tests: **50**. Compile check: Yes (1 page).

### What is tested

**Connections**

- Creates connection request in default status (submit, opportunity ID).
- Launches workflow with new request (submit, opportunity ID with connection request workflow entity).
- Launches workflow with existing request (submit, connection request ID).
- Does not create connection request (submit, opportunity ID when connections disallowed).

**Connection Status field**

- Lists statuses with current selected (page load, connection status field).
- Saves status (submit, connection status selected).
- Keeps existing status (submit, connection status left blank).

**Fields**

- Renders person fields and person attribute (page load, logged in person).
- Shows login required message (page load, anonymous).
- Saves values to person (submit, person fields and person attribute).
- Shows confirmation text (submit, finished).
- Launches workflow with person (submit, person workflow entity).
- Saves values from both forms (submit, two forms).
- Redirects to done page (submit, done page set).

**Groups**

- Adds group member with configured status (submit, group ID of allowed group type).
- Adds group member (submit, group GUID of allowed group type).
- Adds pending group member (submit, group member status pending).
- Launches workflow with group member (submit, group member workflow entity).
- Does not add group member (submit, group ID of disallowed group type).
- Does not add group member (submit, group ID when passing group ID disabled).
- Does not add group member (submit, group membership disallowed).
- Adds group member without page parameter (submit, group setting of disallowed group type).
- Does not add duplicate member (submit, already group member).

**Person mode**

- Shows family member picker (page load, family members mode display picker on).
- Hides family member picker (page load, family members mode display picker off).
- Shows family member picker (page load, anyone mode display picker on).
- Hides family member picker (page load, anyone mode display picker off).
- Hides family member picker (page load, loggedin persononly mode display picker on).
- Hides family member picker (page load, loggedin persononly mode display picker off).
- Reloads form for selected person (select family member, family members mode).
- Saves to family member (submit, family members mode with family member GUID).
- Warns and saves to current person (submit, family members mode with non family GUID).
- Warns and saves to current person (submit, logged in person only mode with person GUID).
- Saves to that person (submit, anyone mode with non family GUID).

**Edit Forms and Fields**

- Preserves configuration (edit forms and fields, open and save).

**Signature document**

- Shows document then saves signed document (submit, signature template).
- Shows warning instead of form (page load, child with disable form for children).
- Shows default warning (page load, child with default warning text).
- Shows form (page load, child with disable form for children off).
- Shows form (page load, adult with disable form for children).
- Shows form (page load, child without signature template).

**SMS checkbox**

- Hides SMS checkbox (page load, SMS checkbox setting off).
- Shows SMS checkbox (page load, SMS checkbox setting on).
- Saves number with messaging enabled (submit, mobile phone with SMS checked).
- Disables messaging (submit, SMS unchecked on messaging number).

**Field visibility rules**

- Shows dependent field (page load, saved value matches rule).
- Hides dependent field (page load, saved value does not match rule).
- Shows dependent field and saves it (edit, value changed to match rule).
- Hides dependent field and does not save it (edit, value changed away from rule).
- Renders form without the field (page load, person field hidden by rule).

### Not tested

- Defaulting a blank Connection Status to Prospect: the form never saves a blank person field, so this fallback cannot be reached.
- Saving after each page (Save Values = each page); the tests save at the end.
- Drawn signatures, signature templates that stay valid for a period, and signature completion emails.
- Visibility rules on fields other than text attributes.

### Known issues

Tests that fail because of these plugin bugs are reported as *known issue* rather than as new failures.

- A visibility rule that hides a person field (for example Middle Name) crashes the form.
- A value typed into a field that a visibility rule then hides is still saved.

## Person Contact Notes

A block for quickly adding a note to a person, or to a group member, that can launch a workflow and change the member's status.

Functional tests: **8**. Compile check: Yes (1 page).

### What is tested

**Group member mode**

- Shows group member drop down instead of person picker (page load, with group ID).
- Reloads for group member (select group member, drop down).
- Saves note and launches workflow for group member (save note, group member workflow entity).
- Activates pending member (save note, set status active workflow).

**Person mode**

- Shows person picker without note editor (page load, no parameters).
- Reloads for person with default note text (select person, person picker).
- Saves note and launches workflow for person (save note, person workflow entity).
- Launches workflow for note (save note, note workflow entity).

### Not tested

- The Allow Backdated Notes, Show Alert Checkbox, Show Private Checkbox and Show Security Button settings.
- The Note View and Person Info Lava templates, Display Note Type Heading, Expand Replies and Display Type.
- Start New Search After Adding a Note.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- One-time Edit rules for the test role on the Personal Note and Group Member Note types (README).

## Round Robin Group Assignment

A job that spreads the people in a data view across a set of groups in turn, optionally keeping families together.

Functional tests: **4**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL).

### What is tested

**Job**

- Assigns each person round robin (run, four people two child groups).
- Adds no one (run, people already assigned).
- Adds family to same group (run, include all family members).
- Removes others from target groups (run, remove members not in data view).

### Not tested

- The Campus, Use Group Campus, Include Selected Groups and Output Errors settings.

## Scheduled Group Communication

Jobs that send a group's scheduled emails and texts, entered as dated items on the group.

Functional tests: **5**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL).

### What is tested

**Email**

- Sends email to group member (email job, one time item due now).
- Item scheduled tomorrow is not sent (email job).
- Sends and moves send date one week (email job, weekly item).

**SMS**

- Sends text from system phone number (SMS job, one time item due now).
- Item scheduled tomorrow is not sent (SMS job).

### Not tested

- Recurrences other than One Time and Weekly.
- The Last Run Buffer setting.

### Manual checks and one-time setup

- Each sending test notes what to check: the email in Edify's outgoing messages and the text on the phone.

## Steps to Care

A care-ministry tool: record care needs, assign care workers, add notes and follow-ups, and track each need on a dashboard.

Functional tests: **18**. Compile check: Yes (1 DLL, 4 pages).

### What is tested

**Actions and notes**

- Offers each configured action (actions, menu).
- Adds care touch (quick note, called).
- Saves note shown in dialog (make note, quick note with text).
- Switches between snoozed and open (snooze, then re open).
- Creates request with need details (add connection request, test opportunity).
- Creates request and opens its detail page (add prayer request).
- Sends need to workflow launcher (launch workflow).
- Opens history page for need (view history).

**Entering care needs**

- Shows assigned need on dashboard (enter care need, self as worker and custom follow up).
- Plus shows family members needs (enter care need, include family).
- Saves details and worker (family need, edit from family row).
- Removes need from dashboard (complete need, from actions).

**Care configuration**

- Opens care configuration (gear, on dashboard).
- Saves worker (care workers, add then edit).
- Saves template (note templates, add then edit).
- Saves defined value (category, add then edit).
- Saves defined value (status, add then edit).

**Notification preference**

- Choice is saved (notification type, all four options).

### Not tested

- The time-driven scenarios run by the Care Need Automated Processes job: scheduled future needs, touch-template flags, automatic follow-up and snooze expiry.
- Automatic worker assignment (turned off on the test pages so no real worker is notified).
- The core Rock pages the plugin links to (Add Prayer Request, Launch Workflow, View History): the tests check the plugin opens the right page, not the page itself.
